findings.behavior: Called only if addr + size > AMDVI_MMIO_SIZE; not emitted for valid CTRL writes.
The valid write handler calls the helper named amdvi_mmio_trace, which emits amdvi_mmio_read.
A same-zero CTRL write emits amdvi_control_status with zero.
The control handler calls amdvi_cmdbuf_run; with disabled command buffer this emits amdvi_command_error(0) and returns before commands or DMA.

required_parent_decision: Accept memory_region_ops_write + amdvi_control_status(0) as valid CTRL write coverage, classify the single disabled-buffer amdvi_command_error(0) as expected rather than command execution, and retain amdvi_mmio_write event absence as a documented producer limitation. No out-of-range write is proposed.
